item.title: [ZEPPELIN-717] ZeppelinContext may not be initialized properly in concurrent mode

item.summary: ZeppelinContext may not be initialized properly in concurrent mode

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
Just take a deeper look into this: I don't think it is related to ZEPPELIN-716

The issue is really strange. I can see ZeppelinContext in the _binder variable, but it is not declared properly by SparkIMain. I am wondering whether there are some shared states among multiple SparkIMains, which may cause some strange issues in concurrent mode

I am not sure about the exact reason, but it seems the issue is gone after I expand the lock to protect the whole process of spark REPL initializing / binding. Need to take a deeper look into the implementation of SparkIMain/SparkILoop

I'll submit a pull request. It'll be great if someone could reproduce this and confirm that this is a real issue.
